source.title: Sash of Lost Inspiration — Live item-side Disenchanting (Wowhead Looter)
source.author: Wowhead Looter cumulative player submissions

notes: Live item-side original Looter table, cloth waist; one original cumulative gear cohort; count/outof are reported hits among disenchants. Zero count is source denominator minus source hits. Positive stack bucket integers uniquely reconstructed from source pctstack percentages (or fixed single-unit stack). Original build, collection epoch, player skill/spec, item bonus and sample overlap with PTR/output-side records unknown; reference only, no estimator import. No Resourcefulness/refund basis documented; gear disenchant once each. Snapshot 2026-11-17.
